Appearance

Robust man in his late 50s, silvery gray hair, short well-groomed beard. Wears simple robes in earthy browns and golden hues with a golden sunburst pendant.

What We Know

High Priest of Pelor at the church near the Adventurers Guild. A warm, community-minded clergyman dedicated to bringing light to Highreach.

First Impressions

Genuinely kind — the sort of priest who remembers your name and asks how you've been.
